ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is rectangle LMNP, with P at the upper left, L at the upper right, M at the lower right, and N at the lower left. The two diagonals PM and LN of the rectangle intersect at J. On the right side, L, K, and M are connected, and quadrilateral LKMJ is a parallelogram; therefore LK is parallel to JM, while JM lies on diagonal PM, and KM is parallel to LJ, while LJ lies on diagonal LN. Reasoning: It is known that m∠PLK = 110°. In rectangle LMNP, LP is perpendicular to LM, so ∠PLM = 90°. Therefore the angle between LK and the vertical side LM is 110° − 90° = 20°. Because LK ∥ JM, and JM lies on diagonal PM, diagonal PM makes 20° with the vertical direction. The two diagonals of a rectangle make equal acute angles with respect to the vertical direction, so the other diagonal LN also makes 20° with the vertical direction. Also because KM ∥ LJ, and LJ lies on diagonal LN, at point K, the direction of KL is parallel to the opposite direction of diagonal PM, and the direction of KM is parallel to diagonal LN. The large angle formed between the two directions is 180° − 20° − 20° = 140°. Therefore m∠LKM = 140°.

method.method_draft: Synthetic angle-chase route: First read the diagram as rectangle LMNP with P upper-left, L upper-right, M lower-right, N lower-left, and with diagonals PM and LN crossing at J. Because LMNP is a rectangle, LP is perpendicular to LM, so the angle between LK and LM is 110 − 90 = 20 degrees. Since LK is parallel to diagonal PM, diagonal PM makes a 20 degree angle with the vertical side LM. In a rectangle, the two diagonals make equal acute angles with a vertical side on opposite sides, so diagonal LN also makes a 20 degree angle with the vertical. Therefore the angle at K between KL, parallel to MP, and KM, parallel to LN, is the large angle between the two diagonal directions: 180 − 20 − 20 = 140.

method.method_draft: Coordinate/vector route: Place the rectangle from the image on a coordinate plane with N = (0,0), M = (w,0), P = (0,h), and L = (w,h). Since J is the intersection of the rectangle diagonals in the picture, J = (w/2,h/2). Because LKMJ is a parallelogram with consecutive vertices L-K-M-J, vector LK equals vector JM = (w/2, -h/2), so the ray LK has slope direction down and right. The given ∠PLK = 110 is the angle between vector LP = (-w,0) and vector LK = (w/2,-h/2); this implies the diagonal direction LK is 70 degrees below the positive horizontal. Thus h/w = tan 70 degrees. At K, vector KL = (-w/2,h/2) has direction 110 degrees from the positive x-axis, while vector KM = (-w/2,-h/2) has direction 250 degrees from the positive x-axis. The smaller difference is 250 − 110 = 140, so m∠LKM = 140.

再推理：按坐标法放置矩形：令 N=(0,0)，M=(w,0)，P=(0,h)，L=(w,h)。因为 J 是矩形对角线交点，所以 J=(w/2,h/2)。在平行四边形 LKMJ 中，连续顶点为 L-K-M-J，因此向量 LK 等于向量 JM。向量 JM=M-J=(w/2,-h/2)，所以 LK=(w/2,-h/2)。

在点 K 处，KL 的方向是从 K 指向 L，即向量 KL=(-w/2,h/2)，方向角为 110°；KM 的方向是从 K 指向 M，即向量 KM=(-w/2,-h/2)，方向角为 250°。两方向角之差为 250°-110°=140°，所以 m∠LKM=140°。
